original.target_description: Experiment 1: paired predicted versus remembered Thanksgiving enjoyment, three-item composite

n.sample_role: University-student participants with both anticipation and retrospection questionnaires; within-person Thanksgiving comparison.
n.exclusions: 16 additional participants completed only anticipation and did not enter the paired comparison; 36 completed both questionnaires.
n.location: Printed p. 291 (PDF p. 3), Experiment 1 Method, Results and Discussion; footnote 1; canonical L492–509, L543–562, L622–633
n.quote: Participants were 36 university students (15 males, 21 females) ... who completed two questionnaires distributed via electronic mail

es.location: Printed p. 291 (PDF p. 3), Experiment 1 Method, Results and Discussion; footnote 1; canonical L492–509, L543–562, L622–633

p.location: Printed p. 291 (PDF p. 3), Experiment 1 Method, Results and Discussion; footnote 1; canonical L492–509, L543–562, L622–633

replication.target_description: Thanksgiving within-subject predicted/remembered enjoyment item (DV2); single item rather than original three-item composite

n.exclusions: General funneling removed two participants unable to mentally time travel and two unable to write about a scenario (p. 38). Main results explicitly described as pre-exclusion on p. 37; subsequent supplementary exclusions are not applied to these printed tests.

reported_success.quote: in the replication study we also found no support in the difference in Thanksgiving Day

notes:
Extracted by neutral outcome description; supplied replication page locators interchange current emotion (DV1, p. 40) and predicted/remembered emotion (DV2, p. 41). No values converted. Replication main tables report pre-exclusion analyses, apart from general funneling. Replication enjoyment item selected because authors explicitly identify it in their abstract; a paired test of the original three-item DV2 composite was not established. Thus replication target_match is false. Supplied replication locator p. 40 is DV1.
Completion source review (n_o): Explicit completed-case sample for Experiment 1 paired analyses.
Completion source review (es_value_o): Printed d for predicted versus remembered enjoyment.
Completion source review (pval_value_o): Printed exact p from the same t test as the extracted d.
